author: Noema II
title: Idea C — mean + multires block‑max mean (b=8) pooling (minimal DSConv baseline) — seed=42 [patched]
abstract: Augment global mean with a multi‑resolution statistic: block‑max (size b=8) then average across blocks. Patched DSConvBlock to use kernel_dilation for Flax 0.10.6. Tests preserving extremes without over‑smoothing.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/noema/submissions')
import jax, jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn

# Import baseline module
import dsconv_minibase_expts2
from dsconv_minibase_expts2 import create_network as build_net, create_optimizer as make_opt

# Patch DSConvBlock to use kernel_dilation (Flax 0.10.6)
class DSConvBlock(nn.Module):
    hidden_dim: int
    kernel_size: int
    dilation: int
    dropout_rate: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic: bool = True):
        residual = x
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.hidden_dim,
                    kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,),
                    feature_group_count=self.hidden_dim,
                    kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,),
                    padding="SAME")(x)
        x = jax.nn.gelu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.hidden_dim, kernel_size=(1,), padding="SAME")(x)
        x = jax.nn.gelu(x)
        return residual + x
dsconv_minibase_expts2.DSConvBlock = DSConvBlock

BASE_SEED = 42
BATCH_SIZE = 64

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        "learning_rate": 0.001,
        "hidden_dim": 256,
        "kernel_size": 7,
        "dropout_rate": 0.10,
        "ds_dilations": [1,2,4,8,16],
        "head_hidden": 128,
        "head_dropout": 0.05,
        "shift_avg": False,
        "multires_b": 8,   # enable block‑max mean with block size 8
        "topk_k": 0,
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return build_net(hparams)

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return make_opt(learning_rate)
